summary: Not a quiet week. The machine has no buyable name for the first time: on 2026-11-19 Ron's session refreshed nine FINAL dives and ACM, the only INVESTABLE call, flipped to WATCH after rising from 70.50 to 80.31 (both sources agree), above its old 61 to 71 zone; its new would-buy band is 46.00 to 54.40. WST flipped WATCH to TOO_LATE (shadow row SHD-20261119-01); the other seven held WATCH with re-anchored bands. Then the market fell: SPY 754.37 on 11-13 to 689.81 on 11-20 (minus 8.6%, minus 3.6% on the last day alone), NVDA 162.85 to 125.53 (new 52-week low), ORCL 125.35 to 101.19, which tripped the week's one new indicator, data-center-moratoria S2 'Deletion, not relocation' (ORCL below 114.99), the scenario that moves ACM's, J's and WSP's link DOWN. No FINAL name is inside its would-buy band except WSP.TO, which is held at WATCH by an admission lapse; the nearest is HALO, 93.04 against an 83.80 top (11% above, price from 11-19). Stale, named: radar paused 81 days, campaign 69 days, no heat or scenario write since 2026-09-14 so every scenario probability predates this drawdown; the rare-earth expiry of 2026-11-10 is still unswept (SIG-20260901-02 61 days past review_by). No routine fired this week except this digest, and no RADAR-DEGRADED line was written. New this week: tools/scorecard.py graded its first 30-day results; with all 207 heat calls backfilled, the composite heat score shows no relation to 30-day excess return yet (Spearman 0.003, n 176), too early to read as edge or its absence. Next week is a cliff: the first 10 shadow rows grade on 2026-11-26 and 45 more on 11-28, and 15 of 18 signal cards plus 8 dives reach review_by between 11-27 and 11-30. Click queue: EMPTY (live version 1795133059-cfdc read directly, queue_check NOT ATTRIBUTED; queue and edits blocks both empty). Feeds 19 of 20 ok, Federal Reserve press releases failing for the fourth digest running. Deferred backlog 142 OPEN by row count (138 at last week's commit under the same count; last week's 128 used a different count).

ranked.title: ORCL tripped the data-center chain's bear scenario: 'Deletion, not relocation'
ranked.case: data/indicators.json added one trip this week: data-center-moratoria S2, ORCL below 114.99, seen 101.19 on 2026-11-20, tripped 2026-11-21. ORCL closed 125.35 on 11-13, 115.00 on 11-17 and 101.19 on 11-20 (yfinance and stockanalysis agree), a new 52-week low against a 248.15 high. S2 is the chain's counter-case: Sightline Climate's estimate that 30 to 50 percent of the 2026 pipeline may be delayed or not delivered, and its links_moved send hyperscale-buildout-demand and power-equipment-shared DOWN LARGE and permitting-and-environmental-consultancy (ACM, J, WSP.TO) DOWN MEDIUM. The card carries S2 at 20% as of 2026-08-30. An indicator trip is not a resolution: ORCL is one name and the whole market fell the same week. What the weekend decides: whether to run `run scenarios data-center-moratoria` so the probabilities are re-set against this week's evidence before ACM, J or WSP.TO are touched again.

So the one call the machine said to act on is now a WATCH, and the 20 FINAL dives read 0 INVESTABLE, 19 WATCH, 1 TOO_LATE.
